📖 How to use

  1. Paste or type your text in the input box.
  2. Click a case button to transform the text.
  3. The result updates live as you type.
  4. Use Copy or Download .txt to save the result.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What does Sentence case do?

It lowercases everything, then capitalizes the first letter of the text and the first letter after every sentence-ending period, exclamation or question mark.

What is iNVERSE cAsE?

It flips the case of every letter: uppercase becomes lowercase and lowercase becomes uppercase.

Is there a text size limit?

No hard limit. Very large pastes may take a moment, but conversion runs entirely in your browser.
